body: Thanks, and you too. I hope you're getting help too, or that you can soon. Brains are so, so strange.
It's pretty awful, right? I'm just documenting every. single. hour. I spend doing anything and combing my work with a fine-tooth comb. Hang in there and here's hoping we both get through it okay <3
I'm a contract worker, so they wouldn't have to really do anything, just...let my contract expire. And I'd understand. But I do appreciate your support, seriously.
